يتسامح (form VI)
# يَتَسَامَحُ (yatasāmaḥu) /ja.ta.saː.ma.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَسَامَحَ (tasāmaḥa)
# يَتَسَامَحَ (yatasāmaḥa) /ja.ta.saː.ma.ħa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَسَامَحَ (tasāmaḥa)
# يَتَسَامَحْ (yatasāmaḥ) /ja.ta.saː.maħ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَسَامَحَ (tasāmaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
